title: Illumina COVIDSeq Test: Amplify cDNA
author: Opentrons
materials: Drop tips into Opentrons Fixed Trash Bin

steps.title: Transfer master mix to Plate 1 (Slot 11)
steps.instruction: Using a fresh 200 µL filter tip, aspirate 200 µL from Column 1 (A1) of the Master Mix Reservoir and dispense 20 µL into Column 1 (A1) of Plate 1 located in Slot 11, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a tip from Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack 200 µL on Slot 10.
Aspirate 200 µL from Column 1 (A1) of the Master Mix Reservoir.
Dispense 20 µL into Column 1 (A1) of Plate 1 on Slot 11.
Drop the used tip into the Opentrons Fixed Trash Bin.

steps.title: Transfer master mix to Plate 1 (Slot 7)
steps.instruction: Using a fresh 200 µL filter tip, aspirate 200 µL from Column 12 (A12) of the Master Mix Reservoir and dispense 20 µL into Column 1 (A1) of Plate 1 located in Slot 7, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a tip from Opentrons 96 Filter Tip Rack 200 µL on Slot 10.
Aspirate 200 µL from Column 12 (A12) of the Master Mix Reservoir.
Dispense 20 µL into Column 1 (A1) of Plate 1 on Slot 7.
Drop the used tip into the Opentrons Fixed Trash Bin.
